title: Read JSON safely
summary: JSON is a text format for structured data. Object keys and string values use double quotes.
introduction: JSON is a text format for structured data. Object keys and string values use double quotes. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: JSON is a text format for structured data. Object keys and string values use double quotes.
The object has text, a number and a boolean. pages is a number because it is not quoted.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add an author string with valid commas and quotes.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: JSON does not allow comments or trailing commas in its standard form.
For more detail later, use this [Postman further reading](https://learning.postman.com/docs/getting-started/overview/).
